description: Eixo Run helps runners and coaches explore stored training data in ChatGPT. Users can search workouts by distance, weather, shoes, sources, comments, and time windows; review runner home, plan, race, shoe, feedback, personal-best, and zone-calibration briefs; inspect coach roster activity, attention items, and athlete context; and prepare data-backed visual briefs for training images.

defaultPrompt: How has my running volume changed over the last eight weeks?
Compare my recent completed runs with my current training plan.
What do my saved threshold and training zones say about my easy-run pace?
